n = int(input())
numbers = list(map(int, input().split()))
T = int(input())

maxGroupSize = 0
numbers.sort()

for startIdx in range(n):
    endIdx = startIdx + 1
    while endIdx < n and abs(numbers[startIdx] - numbers[endIdx]) <= T:
        endIdx += 1
    maxGroupSize = max(maxGroupSize, endIdx - startIdx)
